summary: All images and non-text elements need meaningful alt text, CLI output should be code blocks not screenshots, with RST :alt: and Markdown ![alt](path) syntax.
questions: How do I add alt text to images in RST?
Can I use screenshots of terminal output in docs?

answer_card.title: Images and alt text
answer_card.answer_md:
Give every image meaningful alt text; never screenshot CLI output, use a code block.
```rst
.. image:: path/networkdiag.png
   :width: 400
   :alt: SpiffyCorp network diagram
```
```md
![SpiffyCorp network diagram](path/networkdiag.png)
```
